title: Barton Springs Development Freeze Vote
summary:
*   The city considered and approved the first reading of an ordinance to implement a temporary halt (moratorium) on new development applications within the environmentally sensitive Barton Springs Zone and its contributing watersheds.
*   A public hearing on this proposed development pause was concluded, with the initial moratorium period set for 14 days.
*   The vote to approve the ordinance's first reading passed 4-1, with the Mayor notably casting the dissenting vote.
*   Officials convened a private executive session to receive legal counsel concerning the proposed development moratorium.
